"""Bounded explicit-solver exact and independent-science checks on frozen inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys

repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path[:0] = [str(repo / 'scripts'), str(repo / 'bench')]
import replay_plugins as replay
from native_io import case_header

cases = root / 'replay-candidate/cases'
out = root / 'replay-candidate/explicit'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
candidate = root / 'artifacts/Darwin/setup-candidate.plugin'
baseline = root / 'artifacts/Darwin/post-refactor.plugin'
harness = root / 'sources/setup-candidate/target/actual-plugin-harness/actual_plugin_loader_test'
identities = {str(p): replay.digest(p) for p in (candidate, baseline, harness)}
pairs = [('ols-08', 'cmgschur'), ('ols-25', 'cmgschur')] + [
    (name, solver) for name in ('ppml-bias-exact', 'ppml-bias-randomized')
    for solver in ('cmg', 'lsmr')]
records = []
for name, solver in pairs:
    source = cases / (name + '.case')
    expected = replay.enrich_ols_expected(source, replay.enrich_expected(
        source, json.loads(source.with_suffix('.json').read_text())))
    first = None
    for workers in (1, 4, 8):
        label = f'{name}-{solver}-t{workers}'
        request = out / (label + '.case')
        with source.open('rb') as stream, request.open('xb') as output:
            shape, args = case_header(stream)
            updates = {'solver': solver, 'threads': str(workers)}
            if not expected['poisson']:
                updates['preconditioner'] = 'off'
            args = [a for a in args if a.split(b'=', 1)[0].decode() not in updates]
            args += [f'{k}={v}'.encode() for k, v in updates.items()]
            shape[2] = len(args)
            output.write(('FEREG_REPLAY_V1\n' + ' '.join(map(str, shape)) + '\n').encode())
            for arg in args:
                output.write(str(len(arg)).encode() + b'\n' + arg + b'\n')
            shutil.copyfileobj(stream, output)
        results = [replay.run_case(harness, binary, request, out / (label + '-' + tag + '.json'))
                   for binary, tag in ((baseline, 'accepted'), (candidate, 'candidate'), (candidate, 'repeat'))]
        science = [replay.scientific_errors(result, expected) for result in results]
        exact = [replay.differences(replay.exact_view(results[1], expected['poisson']),
                                   replay.exact_view(other, expected['poisson']))
                 for other in (results[0], results[2])]
        discrete = replay.discrete_view(results[1], expected)
        cross_worker = [] if first is None else replay.differences(first, discrete)
        if first is None:
            first = discrete
        records.append({'label': label, 'source_sha256': replay.digest(source),
                        'input_sha256': replay.digest(request), 'science_errors': science,
                        'exact_differences': exact, 'cross_worker_discrete': cross_worker})
        passed = not any(science) and not any(exact) and not cross_worker
        (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed': all(
            not any(r['science_errors']) and not any(r['exact_differences'])
            and not r['cross_worker_discrete'] for r in records),
            'identities': identities, 'cases': records}, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(label, 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL', flush=True)
        if not passed:
            raise SystemExit(1)
assert {str(p): replay.digest(p) for p in (candidate, baseline, harness)} == identities
assert len(records) == 18
print('EXPLICIT_NATIVE_COMPLETE: 18 cases, 54 native calls', flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,os,subprocess
repo=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();config=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();out=Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'bench'))
import cmg_setup,qualify as q,routing,routing_science as science
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
# A separate 12-call scientific smoke. Timings are not performance observations.
plan=out/'smoke-bound-inputs.json'
manifest=cmg_setup.prepare(config,plan)
records=[]
for item in manifest['cases']:
 meta=q.metadata(manifest,item,plan); snapshots={}
 for role,artifact in manifest['artifacts'].items():
  request=out/(item['id']+'-'+role+'.case')
  routing.prepare(q.resolve(plan,item['input']),request,'baseline' if artifact['request']=='auto' else artifact['request'],4)
  result=out/(item['id']+'-'+role+'.json');log=result.with_suffix('.log')
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in q.ENVIRONMENT}
  env.update({k:'1' for k in q.THREAD_ENV});env['FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE']='1'
  with log.open('xb') as f:
   subprocess.run([str(q.resolve(plan,manifest['harness'])),str(q.resolve(plan,artifact['path'])),'--replay',str(request),str(result)],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env,timeout=120,check=True)
  snapshot=q.read_native(result,log,meta)
  snapshots[role]=snapshot
  if q.affected(meta,artifact['families']):
   family=next(f for f in artifact['families'] if q.affected(meta,[f]))
   cmg_setup.resource_diagnostics(log.read_text(),role,artifact['revision'],family=family)
  records.append({'case':item['id'],'arm':role,'fingerprint':snapshot[2]['fingerprint'],'scientific':'passed'})
  request.unlink()
 q.compare_artifacts(manifest,meta,snapshots)
 print(item['id'],'SCIENCE_SMOKE_PASS',flush=True)
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'passed','purpose':'scientific smoke only; times excluded','calls':records},indent=2)+'\n')
print('SCIENCE_SMOKE_COMPLETE')
